inputClasses: MCP 2025-06-18 (and 2024-11-05 negotiated up) over the same session
invariants: request ids correlate; a mutation without expectedRevision is invalid params (-32602)
a stale writer receives a domain conflict envelope (REVISION_CONFLICT, exit 4) in the result, not a protocol error; the first writer's value survives
a replayed receipt (same requestId and payload, even across a restarted session) returns the original result without re-executing
a changed payload under the same requestId is REQUEST_ID_REUSED with the revision unchanged
malformed transport lines are -32700/-32600/-32601/-32602 with id null; a mutating notification is rejected and writes no receipt
logs go only to the log sink, never on the wire; tools/list exposes only tools runnable under the session evidence policy
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
scope.units: revisions are nonnegative integers; timeoutSeconds seconds; maxMemoryMb megabytes; control values in their descriptor units (metres, degrees, normalized)
excluded: process spawning (the session is driven in-process)

fixtures.path: synthetic:in-process ServeSession over a stub-template project at revision 0
fixtures.note: testReadAndMutationRoundTripWithIdCorrelation: project.inspect, control.set and version correlate ids and persist revision 0 to 1

fixtures.path: synthetic:second writer at expectedRevision 0, changed payload under a reused requestId, malformed and wrong-version lines
synthetic:a mutation sent as a notification, and build on a schema-only registry

mutants.description: testStaleWriterGetsConflictEnvelopeInResult: two writers at expectedRevision 0: the second must get REVISION_CONFLICT (exit 4) in the result and the first value must survive.
testReplayedReceiptReturnsOriginalResult: the same requestId and payload, including from a restarted session, must return the original result with the revision still 1.
testChangedPayloadUnderSameRequestIdIsRejected: a different payload under a reused requestId must be REQUEST_ID_REUSED with no mutation.
testMalformedTransportLinesAreParseErrors: malformed JSON, wrong jsonrpc version, missing method, non-object params and unknown methods must map to the exact JSON-RPC error codes with id null.
testMutatingNotificationsAreRejected: a mutation without an id must be -32600 and write neither a revision nor a receipt.
MCPClientTests.testToolsListFollowsSessionEvidencePolicy: under the release policy with empty evidence tools/list must be empty and tools/call refused; a policy file cannot weaken requireCurrent.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.
